related.title: 三哩島二號機事故後清理工程
related.titleEn: Three Mile Island Unit 2 Post-Accident Cleanup
related.transfer: 可遷移「半衰期與活度衰減」與「集體劑量與作業規劃」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；三哩島二號機事故後清理工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Half-life and decay of activity" and "Collective dose and work planning" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Three Mile Island Unit 2 Post-Accident Cleanup must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦事故廠址的水管理：地下水流入、凍土牆、多核種除去設備與稀釋排放；三哩島二號機事故後清理工程則以爐心熔毀後的十四年：除污、水下取出燃料殘骸、鐵路運送與事故水的蒸發為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on water management at an accident site: groundwater inflow, the frozen soil wall, multi-nuclide removal and diluted discharge; Three Mile Island Unit 2 Post-Accident Cleanup centres on fourteen years after a core melt: decontamination, underwater removal of fuel debris, rail shipment and evaporation of accident water, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「污染水的水量平衡」與「半衰期與活度衰減」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「多核種除去與稀釋倍數」的模型移到三哩島二號機事故後清理工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「探查爐心的空洞」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "The water balance of contaminated water" and "Half-life and decay of activity".
Move the model of "Multi-nuclide removal and the dilution factor" to Three Mile Island Unit 2 Post-Accident Cleanup, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Exploring the void in the core", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「半衰期與活度衰減」與「集體劑量與作業規劃」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；三哩島二號機事故後清理工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Half-life and decay of activity" and "Collective dose and work planning" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Three Mile Island Unit 2 Post-Accident Cleanup must be respecified.

related.title: 車諾比新安全圍阻體
related.transfer: 可遷移「半衰期與活度衰減」與「集體劑量與作業規劃」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；車諾比新安全圍阻體的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Half-life and decay of activity" and "Collective dose and work planning" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Chernobyl New Safe Confinement must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦事故廠址的水管理：地下水流入、凍土牆、多核種除去設備與稀釋排放；車諾比新安全圍阻體則以史上最大的可移動陸上結構：拱形鋼構、滑移就位、遠離輻射源組裝與 2025 年的破損為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on water management at an accident site: groundwater inflow, the frozen soil wall, multi-nuclide removal and diluted discharge; Chernobyl New Safe Confinement centres on the largest movable land structure ever built: the steel arch, sliding into place, assembly away from the source and the breach of 2025, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「污染水的水量平衡」與「拱形鋼構的尺度」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「多核種除去與稀釋倍數」的模型移到車諾比新安全圍阻體，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「容器腐蝕裕度與壽命」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "The water balance of contaminated water" and "The scale of the steel arch".
Move the model of "Multi-nuclide removal and the dilution factor" to Chernobyl New Safe Confinement, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Corrosion allowance and container life", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「半衰期與活度衰減」與「集體劑量與作業規劃」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；車諾比新安全圍阻體的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Half-life and decay of activity" and "Collective dose and work planning" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Chernobyl New Safe Confinement must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 福島第一凍土牆與 ALPS 處理水系統
history.titleEn: Fukushima Daiichi Frozen Soil Wall and ALPS Treated-Water System
history.text: 2011 年事故發生，污染水開始累積；2013 年多核種除去設備開始試運轉；2016 年凍土牆開始凍結；2021 年日本政府決定海洋排放方針；2023 年處理水開始稀釋排放。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2011: The accident occurred and contaminated water began to accumulate. 2013: The multi-nuclide removal system began trial operation. 2016: Freezing of the soil wall began. 2021: The Japanese government decided on discharge to the sea. 2023: Diluted discharge of treated water began. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
